tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Outermost app ground behind the window: the wallpaper fallback and the gutter around floating panels.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and right-panel ground. Nav text (`ink`, `ink-2`) reads on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main workspace ground for every view (Home, Projects, Kanban, Calendar, Library, Canvas chrome).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, note cards, task cards, modals, menus, the composer. Body copy in `ink` sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: search, segmented-control tracks, text inputs, code blocks, the chat user bubble.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav items, rows, icon buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item / active tree row fill. Always paired with `ink` text and weight 600.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, bottom sheets and the mobile sidebar drawer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (1px). Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: inputs, checkboxes, dashed 'add' tiles. 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token (surface-sidebar/surface/surface-raised/surface-inset).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, sidebar items at rest, meta lines. 4.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, section overlines (MAIN, PROJECTS). 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text/icons on `primary` fills (the ink button, the send button, count badges).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one strong action per view: New task, Create project, Send. Ink-black in light, paper in dark; text in `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt ink: links, focus rings, selection outlines, the active chart bar, the cursor in the canvas, @-mentions. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background for accent chips (active @context chip, selected mini-calendar day, text selection).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text and icons: Delete, Clear annotations, sync error. Also the recording dot.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the sync-error banner and destructive-confirm modals.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter marker behind text inside notes (the yellow sweep) — text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: rose-wash

tokens.name: rose-tint
tokens.usage: Rose — priority High, the Pending/blocked column, personal/diary notes. Chip/pill ground (tags, status pills, priority flags) with `rose-ink` text.

tokens.name: rose-edge
tokens.usage: Rose — priority High, the Pending/blocked column, personal/diary notes. 1px border around a `rose-wash` container so it holds its shape on `surface`.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Rose — priority High, the Pending/blocked column, personal/diary notes. Text and icons on `rose-wash` and `rose-tint` (≥4.5:1). Group headings, chip labels.

tokens.name: rose-solid
tokens.usage: Rose — priority High, the Pending/blocked column, personal/diary notes. Non-text marks only: progress dots, chart bars, calendar event rails, folder tabs, the project colour dot.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per view: the page title (Dailies, Project Hub, Kanban Board).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number in StatCard, StreakCard, ChartCard. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Section headings inside a view; modal titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles (project, note, task detail), panel titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stay on top of your papers, notes and tasks.
styles.usage: Default UI text: descriptions, chat messages, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Nav items when selected, task titles, button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, card footers, sidebar items, menu items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, status pills, form field labels, segmented-control items.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section overlines in the sidebar and inspector. Always `ink-3`.

styles.name: note-title
styles.usage: Title of an open note / notepad; NoteCard headline.

styles.name: note-body
styles.sample: The forward process gradually adds Gaussian noise to a molecule graph.
styles.usage: Long-form note text, smart-note output, AI answers longer than three paragraphs.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Task keys, arXiv ids, file sizes, times in the agenda, keyboard hints.

tokens.usage: Gap between stacked chips, icon-to-count.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item padding (x); gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in grids.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Group container padding; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-12
